question: how many students had aims-cameroon trained as of the october 2023 establishment agreement signing
answer: Nearly 450 students from 27 African countries, of whom 37% are women and 46% are Cameroonian.
evidence: Nearly 450 students from 27 African countries have been trained in the Master of Science in Mathematics and Cooperative Master Programs, of whom 37% are women and 46% are Cameroonian.

question: when was the revised establishment agreement signed with the minister of external relations
